notes: Final controller (hand punch, feet planted, COM feedback) was tested on 10 bag positions x 2 seeds spanning z 0.3-1.2: 6/20 succeeded (all bags with z >= 0.9 worked; every bag at z <= 0.8 failed, a few of the lowest also fell). On the practice setup (0.38,-0.15,1.0) it succeeded 20/20 seeds, but that is not included in the 0.3. I did not get a stable one-legged kick or squat for low bags, so low bags are unsupported.
